readme_summary: A twitter-like [nostr][nostr] client for iPhone, iPad and MacOS. Damus has also graciously received donations or grants from hundreds of Damus users, Opensats, and the Human Rights Foundation. damus implements the following [Nostr Implementation Possibilities][nips] - [NIP-01: Basic protocol flow][nip01] - [NIP-04: Encrypted direct message][nip04] - [NIP-08: Mentions][nip08] - [NIP-10: Reply conventions][nip10] - [NIP-12: Generic tag queries (hashtags)][nip12] - [NIP-19: bech32-encoded entities][NIP19] - [NIP-21: nostr: URI scheme][NIP21] - [NIP-25: Reactions][NIP25] - [NIP-42: Authentication of clients to relays][nip42] - [NIP-56: Reporting][nip56] [nips]: https://github.com/nostr-protocol/nips [nip01]: https://github.com/nostr-protocol/nips/blob/master/01.md [nip04]: https://github.com/nostr-protocol/nips/blob/master/04.md [nip08]: https://github.com/nostr-protocol/nips/blob/master/08.
